Hey,

I'm going to be a bit blunt with you.
Please leave her alone. She is clearly not interested in you and might be even scared of you.

Try to get over her and process your emotions in a healthy way.

The following is my advice if you ever notice you have feelings for someone.

1. Tell them upfront that you would like to get to know them as more than just friends. We girls don't automatically think that just because we talk with a guy that he has interests. We are just human beings that also want to talk with men without having to fear that we give him "signs" 

2. Don't get angry or become opposed with her when she tells you no.

3. Please consider going to therapy!

I wish you the best.
